name: Creature Solutions

paragraphs: Anthony from Creature Solutions joins BVS on location for the start of the partnership. He describes being guided through the production process and how the team helped make an unfamiliar task feel manageable.

name: Southern Diesel Supply
label: in Ben’s own words
summary: Ben describes his hesitation about another marketing expense and the return he experienced after starting.
headline: An honest conversation about taking the first step.
paragraphs: For Ben at Southern Diesel Supply, committing to marketing meant taking on another expense. In this conversation with BVS, he talks openly about being hesitant and wondering how the investment would work for his business.

Looking back on his experience, Ben says, “I haven't lost any money. I've only made money doing it.” His account is personal: the clip does not provide an exact return, spending total or reporting period.
The useful question behind his story is one many owners share: what will this investment actually do for the business? Watch Ben explain his decision and how he felt about the outcome.

name: Top Selected Brand
label: one step at a time
summary: Ivan from TSB arrived nervous. He shares how reassurance and step-by-step guidance shaped his first shoot.
headline: You don’t have to arrive knowing how to be on camera.
paragraphs: “I came in here super nervous.” That is how Ivan from Top Selected Brand describes arriving for his first BVS shoot. Standing with Christian in the studio afterward, he talks about the team's professionalism and the reassurance he received.

Ivan highlights being walked through the process step by step. The value he describes is practical: having people beside him who can guide the session and help him feel comfortable doing something unfamiliar.
This video captures the beginning of the relationship and Ivan's experience on the day. It is a first-shoot testimonial, before any campaign results are discussed.

name: iMold Cleaning & Restoration
label: with scripts reviewed ahead
summary: Adam explains how advance scripts, team feedback and patience made iMold’s first video shoot easier.
headline: A first shoot that starts with preparation.
paragraphs: On location in Southwest Florida, Adam from iMold Cleaning & Restoration describes his first shoot with BVS. He credits the preparation before the cameras arrived: scripts were sent in advance, so his team could review them and make sure the language sounded right for the business.
The day still involved multiple takes, which Adam explains was part of trying something new. He says the BVS team worked patiently with them and made the process easier.
Adam finishes the conversation looking forward to seeing the results. His testimonial is about preparation and the production experience; the video does not report campaign outcomes.

name: i9 Sports
label: in the very first month
summary: The goal was 100 new members a month. i9 Sports reports 806 in month one.
headline: A 100-member goal. 806 new members in month one.
paragraphs: i9 Sports came to BVS with a goal of adding 100 new members a month. In the client video, the owner reports 806 new members in the very first month—more than eight times that goal.
The published case study also reports 1,227 leads at $3 per lead. The result that matters most in this story is the new membership: families taking the next step and joining the program.
Hear the owner describe the campaign on the playing field and what the response meant for the business.
